summary: Adia Med, Inc. (formerly Adia Nutrition) filed an 8-K disclosing a verified declaratory-judgment complaint filed September 28, 2026 in Seminole County, Florida circuit court against Tydus Richards and thirteen other named claimants. The suit seeks to quiet title in 29,059,792 common shares — 30.78% of issued and outstanding stock, valued at $3,487,175.04 using the August 13, 2026 close. The company alleges these shares were never paid for or validly issued and stem from a January 2024 change of control via acquisition of the Special 2022 Series A Preferred. No price, premium, or board recommendation stated; watch for title resolution and any ownership overhang.
